```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

1. LOAD THE DATA SET

heart <- read.csv("C:/Users/OAdisa/Desktop/heart.csv")


2. EXPLORE THE DATA

```{r heart}
head(heart)
```


3. DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS

```{r heart}
mean(heart$age)
mean(heart$chol)
mean(heart$thalach)

sd(heart$age)
```


4. CORRELATION ANALYSIS

```{r heart}
cor.test(heart$age, heart$thalach)
cor.test(heart$age, heart$trestbps)
cor.test(heart$age, heart$chol)
```


5. VISUALISATION

```{r heart}
plot(heart$age, heart$thalach,
     main = "Age vs Maximum Heart Rate",
     xlab = "Age", ylab = "Maximum Heart Rate")

plot(heart$age, heart$trestbps,
     main = "Age vs Resting Blood Pressure",
     xlab = "Age", ylab = "Resting Blood Pressure")

plot(heart$age, heart$chol,
     main = "Age vs Cholesterol",
     xlab = "Age", ylab = "Cholesterol")
```


6. COMPARE HEART RATE BY SEX

```{r heart}
boxplot(thalach ~ sex, data = heart,
        main = "Maximum Heart Rate by Sex",
        xlab = "Sex", ylab = "Maximum Heart Rate")

wilcox.test(thalach ~ sex, data = heart)
```
